title: Determination on Committee of Privileges Findings on the Conduct of Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap
what_it_is: Determination on Committee of Privileges Findings on the Conduct of Ms Sylvia Lim and Mr Faisal Manap

sections.label: Motion on Pritam Singh conduct
sections.summary: On 14 January 2026 the House debated and passed a Motion on Mr Pritam Singh's conduct and his suitability as Leader of the Opposition.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: On 14 January 2026, this House debated and passed a Motion on "Expression of Regret at the Conduct of Mr Pritam Singh and Consideration of His Suitability to Continue as the Leader of the Opposition".

sections.label: Findings on Lim and Faisal
sections.summary: The question is what to do with the COP Report findings that Ms Lim and Mr Faisal were untruthful about the 8 August meeting.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The question is what to do with the findings regarding Ms Lim and Mr Faisal in the COP Report on the "Complaint against Ms Raeesah Khan for Untruth Spoken in Parliament", specifically the Committee's finding that Ms Lim and Mr Faisal were untruthful to the COP about what was said at the 8 August meeting.

sections.label: PPIPA section 22 punishment power
sections.summary: Under section 22 of the PPIPA, Parliament may punish offences committed in the preceding session or the last session of the preceding Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Under section 22 of the PPIPA, Parliament has the power to punish offences which have been committed in either (a) the preceding session or (b) the last session of the preceding Parliament.

sections.label: 15th Parliament jurisdiction limits
sections.summary: The 15th Parliament can only deal with offences from this Session or the Second Session of the 14th Parliament, so no penalties apply.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Under section 22 of the PPIPA, this 15th Parliament can only deal with offences committed either in this Session of the 15th Parliament, or during the Second Session of the 14th Parliament.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As the conduct in question took place during the First Session of the 14th Parliament, it is no longer open to this 15th Parliament to impose any penalties in respect of this conduct under the PPIPA.

sections.label: No further action needed
sections.summary: Given the specific circumstances, the view is that no further action need be taken on the Committee's finding regarding Ms Lim and Mr Faisal.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Given the very specific circumstances of this case, it is my view that no further action need be taken by this House in relation to the Committee's finding regarding Ms Lim and Mr Faisal.

sections.label: Speaker's response to Minister
sections.summary: The Speaker asks the Leader of the House to keep answers clear and concise, does not object to the Minister's proposal, and will not repeat his 14 January responses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Likewise, I will ask Leader of the House to also keep your answers clear and concise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I have noted what the Minister is proposing that the House do.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I am not standing up to object to it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: But I think it is important for me to also state that my response on some of the issues that she mentioned, I have made them on 14 January during the debate on the Motion of the Leader of the Opposition, and I do not think I need to repeat them.
